title: Pesto Cassava Fritters
description: A classic Italian-inspired fritter recipe featuring cassava and pesto, perfect as a side or snack.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine grated cassava, pesto, flour, salt, and pepper. Mix well.
Add the beaten egg and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth.
Cover the dough and let it rest for 30 minutes.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
Shape each piece into a ball and flatten slightly into a disk shape.
Cook the fritters for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Serve hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
